title.narrative: Countering and Preventing Terrorism in Pakistan

description.narrative:
OO: The relevant departments of Government of Pakistan are capable to investigate and adjudicate terrorism cases; the victims of terrorism have better support as legal frameworks are in place; and the community has enhanced resilience against extremism.

SO1: The Criminal Justice Institutions effectively investigate, process, and adjudicate terrorism cases, leading to improved counterterrorism efforts and the successful prosecution of terrorists.

SO2: Support mechanism for victims of terrorism is strengthened, with enhanced coordination, institutional capacity, and effective funding mechanism

SO3: The community resilience against violent extremism is strengthened by establishing integrated networks and promoting civil society engagement
